text: おれは　やまに　すんで　ながい　よそものに　でかい　つらは　させん

structure.jp: おれは　やまに　すんで　ながい
structure.en: I've lived in the mountains a long time

structure.jp: よそものに　でかい　つらは　させん
structure.en: I won't let an outsider act big

patterns.name: 〜てながい
patterns.explanation: A て-form followed by ながい says that something has been going on for a long time. すんで　ながい = 'have lived (there) a long time'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.span: よそものに　でかい　つらは　させん
patterns.explanation: させる is する changed to mean 'let or make someone do it'; the person is followed by に. よそものに　でかい　つらは　させん = 'I won't let an outsider act like a big shot'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ん in place of ない is a gruff, older-man way of saying 'not'. させん = 'won't let'.
